data.gender_notes: Munawwara is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'nawwara' which means 'to adorn' or 'beautify'. In Islamic context, Munawwara symbolizes the inner beauty and grace of a woman, reflecting the virtues of kindness, wisdom, and trustworthiness. The name Munawwara carries the meaning “Adorned, beautiful one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Munawwara usually hope their child will grow to embody adorned, beautiful one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Munawwara total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

It resonates with the prophetic sayings that a beautiful woman is one whose heart is attractive and pleasing to Allah. Munawwara also inspires us to be adorned with good deeds and excellent character, embodying the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) teachings on the importance of inner beauty and moral values. The name serves as a reminder to constantly improve ourselves, both internally and externally, to mirror the divine beauty of Allah SWT.
